task.title: Deploying a local instance of Red Hat Quay in IPv6
task.shortdesc: To deploy a local Red Hat Quay instance over IPv6, you can set FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION in config.yaml and start the registry container with explicit IPv6 port mappings.

ul.li: You have configured Redis, your PostgreSQL database, local image storage, and creating a config.yaml file with the desired settings.

context.p: After you have created a new dual-stack container network, you can deploy a local instance of Red Hat Quay.
